name: katana-markdown-linter
description: Markdown lint diagnostics and workspace-scoped safe fixes through MCP stdio.

tools.name: check_text
tools.description: Return Markdown diagnostics for provided text without reading files.

tools.name: fix_text
tools.description: Return fixed Markdown text without writing files.

tools.name: check_file
tools.description: Check one Markdown file inside the configured workspace root.

tools.name: fix_file_preview
tools.description: Preview safe fixes for one workspace file without writing it.

tools.name: fix_file_apply
tools.description: Apply safe fixes to one workspace file only when apply is true.

workspace_root.title: Workspace Root
workspace_root.description: Directory that kml-mcp may read and update only through explicit apply.
